initiatives.name: Muslims for Just Futures
initiatives.description: Muslims for Just Futures (MJF) is a grassroots organization that builds power in Muslim communities through collective care, organizing, advocacy, and movement-building.

initiatives.name: Council on American-Islamic Relations (CAIR)
initiatives.description: National Muslim civil rights and advocacy group with state chapters. It handles discrimination complaints and legal cases, tracks anti-Muslim incidents, and lobbies on policy.

initiatives.name: MPower Change
initiatives.description: Muslim-led digital advocacy group, founded in 2016, that runs national campaigns against Islamophobia and surveillance, plus voter engagement (#MyMuslimVote) and Palestine solidarity work.

initiatives.name: Muslim Advocates
initiatives.description: National Muslim civil rights organization based in Washington, DC. It files lawsuits and FOIA requests and publishes know-your-rights resources.

initiatives.name: Muslim Legal Fund of America (MLFA)
initiatives.description: Texas-based nonprofit that pays for legal defense of Muslims in the US in criminal, civil and immigration cases, and runs community education on legal rights.

initiatives.name: ICNA Relief
initiatives.description: Muslim charity in the US run by ICNA. It runs food pantries, transitional housing, family services, health services and disaster relief.

initiatives.name: Muslim Anti-Racism Collaborative (MuslimARC)
initiatives.description: Nonprofit that makes anti-racism curriculum and trainings for Muslim communities and institutions. Mailing address is in Alta Loma, CA.

initiatives.name: Muslim Justice League
initiatives.description: Boston-based group working on Muslim civil rights, including campaigns against surveillance technology, countering violent extremism programs, and police abuse.
